briefs.brief: The desk holds LITE as STRENGTHENING (live since 2026-09-03, re-entered after a 09-01 exit) and ranks it 1 (leader) in AI Networking/Optics as of 09-21, unchanged from 09-08 and 09-14. Support: Q4 FY26 revenue $1.01B vs $987.7M consensus, EPS $3.23 vs $2.97, Q1 FY27 guide >$1.25B revenue and >39% op margin (2026-08-11). The 09-14 sell-off (LITE -9% on Corning's $2bn ATM) was sentiment/contagion; no hyperscaler capex cut found through 09-20, and LITE rebounded +3% on 09-18. Case against: already the price leader (+12.48% 1m), single-customer NVDA concentration. LITE/COHR judged redundant on business grounds (keep LITE, drop COHR); no return correlation measured.

A second qualified 200G/lane EML source, most plausibly COHR at volume, removes the rank-1 argument
Cluster at 23.41% vs 21% band top (09-16): no room regardless of thesis
GLW ATM re-escalates only on a program-usage disclosure; Amodei essay re-escalates only on a hyperscaler capex move
open_questions: Rationale for the 09-01 exit was flagged as uncaptured (G78) in earlier ladder notes
